chung.Syllabus Name: 3D Character Animation_Tạo chuyển động trong môi trường 3D
chung.Pre-Requisite: Passed (ANR401 or ANR402) or passed (AMR401 or AMR402)
chung.Description: This course covers character rigging and animation in Maya. Students will learn to rig characters, animate with keyframe techniques, analyze body language and expressions and apply animation principles for realistic motion. They will be able to create and render a short animation scene using Maya and compositing software while also developing a positive and professional working style.
chung.StudentTasks:
- Attend at least 80% of contact hours in order to be accepted to the final examination
- Actively participate in class activities
- Fulfill tasks given by instructor after class
- Use their own laptop in class only for learning purposes.
- Read the textbook in advance
- Access the course website (https://flm.fpt.edu.vn/) for up-to-date information.

Students can use AI during the ideation stages: creating reference poses, generating camera angles, and developing mood boards for lighting and colors.

The evaluation will consider the following criteria: Animation quality and effort in creating a scene: 50%. Application of animation principles and techniques: 30%. Effective use of AI during the ideation phase: 10%. Presentation skills, including the ability to explain the work and respond to evaluator questions: 10%.
These criteria are defined by teachers as part of the teaching process.

Individual

When submitting their work, students must include a report that details:
- The AI tools used
- The prompts used
- The AI-generated images used for reference
- Additionally, they should include other reference sources, if any (from the internet, self-shot materials, etc.).
